mentions.name: Patched SDCC build
mentions.description: A patched build of the SDCC compiler containing fixes for the miscompiles and performance issues encountered while building Game Gear test ROMs; the work included downloading the entire issue tracker and fuzzing the compiler to find bugs.
mentions.problem: SDCC is full of miscompiles and performance issues that caused repeated problems while building ROMs.
mentions.source_excerpt: SDCC is the compiler I'm using for the ROMs and it's full of miscompiles and performance issues, so I'm running a patched build with everything I know about fixed, because I kept running into stupid issues while making the aforementioned ROMS (downloaded the whooole issue tracker and even fuzzed it a bit).
